rationale_bullets: Milivojevic earned the job in November: 71.3 PFF/205 dropbacks (B10 +1 -> 72.3, at the p50 unit reference), 64.2% with 10-3 over the final four starts (PS); 'his QB Rating would have placed ninth in the Big Ten' (P6).
The named tax (Athlon): 25 sacks in his four starts - 'he'll need a quicker trigger and help from his offensive line' - and the line is now five new starters.
Sample honesty: 205 dropbacks is a hint-plus, not a season; a new OC (Sheridan) installs on top of it.
Depth is genuinely useful: Fancher (62.7/98 at UCF; 28 career FBS starts) 'will push Milivojevic' (PS).
53, M = fringe-average: the adjusted tape is average-P4-starter quality, the sample and the sack context cap it.

Patterson (77.4/60 at IOWA - B10-real tape, tiny sample; 811 @ 4.5 over three years) and Parrish (WKU; 576 @ 5.4; C-USA All-Freshman) give proven-level depth; K.Williams (Nebraska) adds return value.

McCray (64.9/268 -> 63.9) is the room's proven piece - a portal withdrawal who stays and 'steps up into the lead role' (P6).

The adds are priors, not production: KK Smith (73.3 on 50 routes at ND), F.Moore (45.9/5 at Michigan) - 'high-potential players stuck in crowded rooms... three-star transfers' (P6) - and D2 'Super Back' Gulker (73 career TDs at Ferris State; no FBS tape, heavy level judgment).
Top250 FR Gash (#1 WR recruit in Michigan) 'could earn playing time right away' (P6).

rationale_bullets: One returning starter - C.Moore (68.3/765 -> 67.3), the only returning offensive starter on the team - after losing seven OL (38 career starts) incl. the best tape (Gulbin 82.6/727, yr4) and Ramil (74.3/163, to Auburn).

Five imports with 72 career starts (PS): Murawski (75.9/773 at UCONN - the IND-cell -22 mechanical is too dark for a line both books tout; judged mid-60s effective), Wright (67.4/752, Ga Southern), Sharpe (65.9/392 at South Carolina, SEC +13 -> 78.9), Fraley (NDSU - FCS All-American and FCS Rimington winner, level-discounted).
The context that matters for the QB grade too: 37 sacks allowed (PBLK 12th pctile), 25 in Milivojevic's four starts.
Coach-attributed optimism, weighted as opinion: Fitzgerald says the group 'improved most in the spring... all 5 OL have all-conference potential' (PS).
Mechanical mix ~64 (~p42) minus five-new-starters gel risk = 46, M.
Five DL gone (29 starts - PS): VanSumeren (66.6/476) to USC, Thompson (68.2/420) to ASU, Santiago (72.3/248) to Kansas, Kelly + Dunnigan expired. The proxy prints a BLANK for the unit.

What returns: I.Smith (63.5/286 -> 73.5; yr4 RETURNS override - P6 explicit + PS one-starter-back arithmetic, with Athlon's two-deep omission documented as the dissent), Roberts (69.9/161 -> 79.9; 'playing well at DT before a midseason injury' - P6), Top250 4* Simmons ('ready for a breakout').

The adds are non-AQ or modest-tape: Soares (58.2/656 at NC State -> 59.2; PFF-classed LB, plays EDGE here per two-deep; PS 'figures to be the top pass rusher'), Coenen (61.4/222 at Illinois -> 71.4), Hazelwood (78.1/83 at Toledo -> 72.1, small sample), Weber St + SEMO depth.
Athlon is blunt: 'the defensive line room is thin again, which will cause problems'; 9 takeaways in 2025 (6th-fewest) is pinned on the front.
Mechanical aggregate ~67 (~p48) is dragged by Soares's high-volume mediocre tape; the I.Smith override risk and depth thinness land it at 44, M.
